Apr 2026 • Friends
Shocking service. I ordered chicken and got fish. Not a problem as it looked nice. However, it was 100k Dong more. The same with the rice we asked for steamed brown rice and they gave some with nuts. Another 100k extra. Well done, you took money off us but we won't be back and I'll tell every ex pat I know.
Insider tip:
Steer clear of it.

Written April 5, 2026
Danh Tran
Dear 246keitha,

Greetings from Quán Bụi. Thank you for taking the time to provide your feedback. We are deeply sorry and concerned to learn that serious service errors caused you to have a negative impression, leading to a misunderstanding regarding our restaurant's integrity.

Regarding the mix-up between the chicken and fish orders, as well as the brown rice, we would like to clarify: This was entirely an operational error by our staff in recording and serving the wrong items, which resulted in the price discrepancies on your bill (an additional 100,000 VND per item). Properly, our staff should have clearly explained the situation and corrected the order to match what you originally requested, or sought your approval before serving an alternative. We believe there was a misunderstanding where both parties did not fully grasp each other's intent during the interaction. Quán Bụi commits that we never have a policy of arbitrarily changing dishes to overcharge guests, as transparency and guest trust are our top priorities.

We will take strict disciplinary action against the staff members on duty for this lack of attentiveness. What worries us most now is how to make amends and regain the trust of a valued guest like yourself. We kindly ask for your understanding and hope you will accept our most sincere apologies. Quán Bụi is very eager to reconnect with you to refund the overcharged amount and provide proper support to make up for this experience.

Please reach out via Email: marketing@quan-bui.com or leave your phone number so we can contact you directly. We wish you good health and truly hope you will give us an opportunity to welcome you back to witness our sincere improvements.

Sincerely,
Quán Bụi Management Team
